## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) — the DCO is required (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)).
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `go test ./...` passes.
- [ ] Schema changes (if any) are **additive** — existing fields keep their meaning.
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed; no claim overstates what the code does (e.g. the ledger is tamper-evident, not tamper-proof).
- [ ] Change honors the invariants in [`docs/constitution.md`](../docs/constitution.md); any change to those invariants is its own explicit amendment commit.
